label: Test Dress 4 (3D Scan Demo)
name: Test Dress 4
description: RealityScan photogrammetry export, decimated directly from the dense textured scan (5.0M faces to 100k, keeping RealityScan's own UVs and texture at 4K) via garment-capture-pipeline/decimate_dense_textured.py. This scan's own export used a Z-up axis convention (unlike Test Dress 0/1's Y-up), so a -90 deg rotation about X was applied. The retopologize-and-rebake route used for Test Dress 0-3 was tried first and produced smeared texture and black blocks on the center-front placket, so it was replaced for this garment. model3d_rotationY set to 180 (confirmed 2026-09-23 via visual check) to face forward.

label: DR.2023.17 (3D Scan Demo)
name: DR.2023.17
description: RealityScan photogrammetry export, decimated directly from the dense textured scan (5.0M faces to 100k, RealityScan's own UVs and texture at 4K) via garment-capture-pipeline/dense_to_glb.py, with --srgb-encode applied (RealityScan's raw diffuse reads dark/orange/oversaturated otherwise). This scan's own export used a Z-up axis convention, so a -90 deg rotation about X was applied. Sixth garment in the pilot dataset (features.csv/pca_sanity_check.py), the first captured under its real accession number directly rather than a generic testdressN placeholder. model3d_rotationY set to 45 on 2026-09-28 via visual check, then corrected to 0 (45 deg clockwise from a top-down/turntable view, per Matthew's follow-up) the same day.
